features: A Beginner’s Keyboard with 61 Piano Style Keys For Those Who’re Looking to Learn a Musical Instrument'
Incredibly Easy To Use with Its Big and Clear LCD Display and an Easy User Interface, 30 User Song Banks

Compatible With Casio’s Mobile Application “Chordana Play” Which Helps You Learn All Your Favourite Songs. Just Download and Import the Midi File Into the App and Connect Your Phone To The Keyboard with an Aux Cable
Equipped With 400 Tones and 100 Rhythms, The CTK-2550 is Extremely Versatile
Contains 13 Authentic Indian Tones and 12 Indian Rhythms
Jam and Create Your Own Musical Composition By Using the Dance Music Mode. Further Add Build-Up Effects To Boost Your Performance
CTK-2550 Comes with a Free Adaptor (LAD-6). It Can Be Operated Using Batteries as Well and Requires 6 AA Batteries
2 Watts + 2 Watts Speakers Gives an Ample Amount of Sound Output For Practicing
